title: kith-jmap: add compile/test check for METHOD_ROLES vs register() sync
description: METHOD_ROLES and Dispatcher::register() are decoupled. A handler registered without a corresponding METHOD_ROLES entry silently fails with unknownMethod. A METHOD_ROLES entry without a registered handler also silently fails. Neither is caught at compile time or by the test suite. Add a test that iterates METHOD_ROLES and asserts every method name has been registered in a Dispatcher, or restructure so registration and role metadata live together.
